verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad API reference: HTTP V2 ingestion, export, Dashboard REST, taxonomy CRUD and cohorts. A probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, which could back an interactive explorer. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is actually interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/API explorer, runnable code examples within the reference, and independent or hands-on confirmation of either.
